font-size:0 is also an inline-block spacing hack: a descendant restoring a non-zero size does render, so its text is kept

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<div style=\"font-size:0\"><span style=\"font-size:14px\">restored and visible</span></div>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
